name: SprintFlow Rich Artifacts
description: Renders agent-authored rich artifacts — Mermaid diagrams, charts, sandboxed React interfaces and images — as custom post types in the chat stream.

settings_schema.header: Authenticated access to SprintFlow artifacts. The browser cannot reach ai-core directly, so this plugin forwards artifact reads after checking that the viewer may read the channel and post the artifact was published in.

settings.help_text: Internal URL of ai-core, e.g. http://ai-core:8000. Falls back to SPRINTFLOW_AICORE_URL.
Must equal RICH_MEDIA_PLUGIN_TOKEN in ai-core. Falls back to SPRINTFLOW_PLUGIN_TOKEN.
